rows.textLatex: Assuming that the shape of the overhead line can be approximated by a parabola, deduce the expression for calculating sag.

rows.topic: Unequal Support Sag & River Crossing Clearance
rows.textLatex: An overhead line has a span of $336\text{ m}$. The line is supported at a river crossing from two towers whose heights are $33.6\text{ m}$ and $29\text{ m}$ above the water level. The weight of conductor is $8.33\text{ N/m}$ and the tension in the conductor is not to exceed $3.34\times 10^{4}\text{ N}$. Determine the clearance between the lowest point on the conductor and water. Also find the horizontal distance of this point from the lower support.
What do you understand by grading of a cable? What is the difference between capacitance grading and intersheath grading?

rows.topic: Electric Stress & Economical Size of Single-Core Cable
rows.textLatex: Derive the formula for the electric stress in a single core cable. Also, determine the most economical size of a cable.
Why V strings are used in transmission lines?
Discuss the methods used to minimize vibration in transmission line.
What are the criteria for suggesting tariff?
Explain generation guided and load guided tariff.
Explain the electrical failures occurring in an Insulator. How are they taken care of?
Justify the statement: The steel in ACSR conductor does not affect its ampacity
What do you understand by demand factor and load factor?

rows.topic: Generating Station Energy, Diversity & Demand Factor
rows.textLatex: A generating station supplies the following loads: $150\text{ MW}$, $120\text{ MW}$, $85\text{ MW}$, $60\text{ MW}$ and $5\text{ MW}$. The station has a maximum demand of $220\text{ MW}$. The annual load factor of the station is $0.48$. Calculate (i) the energy supplied annually (ii) the diversity factor and (iii) the demand factor.
What are the disadvantages of using 3 core belted cable? How can they be overcome?

A $2.5\text{ km}$ long, $33\text{ kV}$, three phase underground cable using three single core cables has conductor radius of $1.3\text{ cm}$ and insulation thickness of $0.8\text{ cm}$. The power factor of the unloaded cable is $0.03$ and relative permittivity of the dielectric is $3.1$. Determine capacitance per phase, charging current per phase, total charging kVAr, dielectric loss per phase and maximum electric stress in the cable.
What is Stringing chart and why is it important?
Explain the necessity of load forecasting.
Illustrate Murray loop test for short circuit fault location with necessary circuit diagram.

rows.topic: Sending End Voltage & Regulation from ABCD Constants
rows.textLatex: A $200\text{ km}$ three phase $50\text{ Hz}$ transmission line has the following constants: $A = D = 0.96\angle 1^\circ$ and $B = 100\angle 80^\circ\text{ ohms}$. If the line supplies a load of $30\text{ MW}$ at $0.8$ p.f. lag at $132\text{ kV}$, determine the sending end voltage and voltage regulation.
Derive a formula for calculating the voltage developed by electrostatic effect in a communication line due to a nearby power line.
Explain what you understand by tuned power lines.

rows.topic: Internal Flux Linkages of a Conductor
rows.textLatex: Derive an expression for calculating the internal flux linkages for a conductor carrying current.
Derive the expression for the velocity of travelling waves in transmission lines. Why the velocity of travelling waves is less in underground cables compared to overhead transmission lines?

A $400\text{ km}$, three phase, $50\text{ Hz}$, overhead power transmission line has series impedance $z = (0.01+j0.25)\text{ ohm/km/phase}$ and shunt admittance $y = j4\times 10^{-6}\text{ mho/km/phase}$. Calculate (i) the characteristic impedance, (ii) velocity of wave propagation and (iii) wave length of the traveling waves in the line.
What do you understand by Surge Impedance Loading (SIL) of a line? Explain why the higher value SIL is preferred and propose any one method to increase the SIL.

rows.topic: Travelling Waves on Long Transmission Lines
rows.textLatex: Show that voltage at any point of a long transmission line can be resolved into two traveling waves in opposite direction.
What do you understand by attenuation constant and phase shift constant?

The ac resistance of a conductor is more than dc resistance.

The electromagnetic interference between power line and communication line can be fully nullified by transposition of communication line.
